items.title: EIP-8037：澄清 frame 失败时状态 gas 的处理（子 frame 与顶层）
items.note: （qu0b）提交：子 frame 失败时 execution_state_gas_used 归还给父 frame 储备而不累加，顶层异常停止时不清零、仍计入 block_state_gas_used。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: clarify state gas behavior on frame failure (child vs top-level)
items.note_en: (qu0b), submitted: on child frame failure execution_state_gas_used returns to the parent's reservoir rather than accumulating, and on top level exceptional halt it is not reset and still counts toward block_state_gas_used.

items.title: ethresear.ch：以太坊状态的分片 PIR 设计
items.note: （aliatiia 与 Keewoo Lee）04:30：私有信息检索让用户从远程服务器读取链上数据而服务器不知道读了什么；各类 PIR 方案性能取舍不同，以太坊数据的更新频率与延迟敏感度也不同，按数据集分片并匹配最优方案，可在相同隐私保证下获得更好整体性能。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Sharded PIR Design for the Ethereum State
items.note_en: (aliatiia and Keewoo Lee), 04:30: private information retrieval lets users read chain data from remote servers without the server learning what was read; PIR schemes trade off differently and Ethereum data varies in update rate and latency sensitivity, so sharding data and pairing each set with its best scheme gives better overall performance at the same privacy.

items.title: 新增 ERC：钱包签名与 calldata 摘要显示
items.note: （PatrickAlphaC）提交：定义 EIP-712 摘要、域哈希、消息哈希与 calldata 摘要四个术语，要求钱包显示以便独立核验。
items.title_en: Add ERC: Wallet Signature and Calldata Digest Display
items.note_en: (PatrickAlphaC), submitted: defines EIP-712 digest, domain hash, message hash and calldata digest, and requires wallets to display them for independent verification.

summary_en: drakefjustin said two papers improving Shor's algorithm landed the same day, pulling the quantum timeline forward again. Aztec Alpha went live, billed as the first feature complete privacy stack on Ethereum. ethresear.ch proposed sharding Ethereum state and pairing each part with its best PIR scheme so users can read chain data without revealing what they read. forshtat proposed moving the native AA proposal EIP-7701 to Withdrawn while his EIP-8209 merged.
